description.value: BC LIQUOR Port Alberni is a provincial government liquor retail store on 10th Avenue in Port Alberni, part of the 198-store BCLIQUOR network operated by the BC Liquor Distribution Branch. It stocks wine, spirits, beer, coolers, ciders, and non-alcoholic beverages, and accepts credit and debit cards. OSM notes wheelchair accessibility, and the store offers a container-recycling deposit refund program.
